scope: bootstrap local and live GitHub delivery surface

findings.claim: Delivery state cannot be bound to an exact revision because no commit exists.
findings.evidence: Local HEAD is all zeroes and GitHub reports an empty repository.
findings.impact: No reproducible release identity or live control evidence.
findings.recommended_slice: Create a reviewed initial commit and publish main.

findings.claim: No CI or merge gate exists.
findings.evidence: No local workflows and no live workflow registration or branch protection.
findings.impact: Tests and schema validation are bypassable.
findings.recommended_slice: Add pinned cross-platform validation and protect one stable contract context.

findings.claim: The public repository has no automated dependency, code-scanning, or private-reporting controls.
findings.evidence: No Dependabot, dependency review, CodeQL, or security policy is present.
findings.impact: Vulnerable dependencies and unsafe disclosures have no governed path.
findings.recommended_slice: Add proportional public-repository security automation and policy.

findings.claim: Contribution and review expectations are not encoded in GitHub surfaces.
findings.evidence: No CODEOWNERS, pull-request template, issue forms, contribution policy, or license.
findings.impact: Integrity boundaries can be missed during otherwise valid changes.
findings.recommended_slice: Add public-safe contribution surfaces aligned with repository authority.
